prompt:
Create an original photorealistic MACRO OPENING FRAME for the exact perfume campaign in the reference image. Identity and lighting lock: preserve this same ants FIRST LIGHT bottle, its glass geometry and cap material, clear liquid, pale blue-white morning light and quiet water environment. This image will be the START of one continuous slow cinematic camera pull-back that ends at the reference full-product photograph.
Composition: wide 16:9 landscape, left 43 percent a very soft nearly white pale-blue defocused field for actual webpage text. On the right half, an extreme close-up of the curved transparent glass SHOULDER just below the same matte white cap. Show only this small part of the bottle, naturally cropped by the close camera. A few tiny 1-3 mm real clear water beads adhere directly to the glass shoulder with natural surface tension; one small round bead is tack sharp around 70 percent of the image width and 48 percent height. The bead is not an independent object. It has a delicate highlight, a subtle tiny refracted image of the pale watery environment and physically believable shadow/contact. A thin optical glass rim sweeps gently toward the lower right, with beautiful slate-blue edge reflection, genuine material thickness and sculpted soft light. A subtle matte-white cap edge may appear toward upper right but must never read as a huge block. Underlying glass remains visibly glass, not clay, jelly, plastic or rough frost. Very refined 100 mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, tactile water bead, real optical details. Art-directed restraint with actual recognizable material. No huge egg-shaped drop, no bubbles hovering in the foreground, no rings, no splash, no text outside the product, no graphic, no UI, no watermark. No added props, flowers or objects. Clean commercial perfume photography, not CGI. The size of each bead relative to the bottle is tiny; it is enlarged only by the camera's macro proximity.
